simulateur.footnote: Assumption: 36 members minimum per group · You contribute for 12 months and receive the pot on your turn (11 months net) · The 1st month is the annual sign-up fee

whatIsDbc.description: DBC is the Business branch of the Les Déployés movement. Founded in Yaoundé, it is building a pan-African entrepreneurial ecosystem giving entrepreneurs access to the resources, skills and opportunities they need to grow their business.
